A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' worked as a receptionist for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]]. She had a romantic relationship with [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|Director of]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Marcus Trant]].
